answer: Require every agent identity to be backed by a basalt-hard stake: a refundable deposit locked for a full epoch, slashed on duplicate or spam behavior. Creating a thousand fake identities then costs a thousand stakes, while one honest agent pays once. Reputation accrues only from attested work over time, like pigment settling layer by layer, so a newcomer cannot buy instant trust at the summit of the ranking. Sybils stay expensive, slow, and visible.
